features.name: Parser Infrastructure (tree-sitter)
features.description: Multi-language tree-sitter parser orchestration. All 7 language parsers registered, wired, and tested in parser/mod.rs.

features.name: Rust Parser
features.description: Full tree-sitter AST parsing for Rust: functions, methods, structs, enums, traits, impls, const/static, let declarations, modules. Cyclomatic complexity, compact signatures.

features.name: TypeScript/JavaScript Parser
features.description: tree-sitter-typescript parsing: class, function, import, enum, const, let, arrow functions. Shared parser for .ts, .tsx, .js, .jsx.

features.name: Python Parser
features.description: tree-sitter-python parsing: class, async/def methods, imports, variables, tuple destructuring.

features.name: Go Parser
features.description: tree-sitter-go parsing: struct, method (with receiver), function, const, var, imports.

features.name: Java Parser
features.description: tree-sitter-java parsing: class, method, imports.

features.name: C Parser
features.description: tree-sitter-c parsing: function, struct, #define constants, #include imports.

features.name: C++ Parser
features.description: tree-sitter-cpp parsing: function, class, method (with parent tracking), namespace modules, #include imports.

features.name: FTS5 Full-Text Search with BM25
features.description: SQLite FTS5 virtual table for symbol search with BM25 ranking (name weight=10.0, signature=2.0, file_path=1.0). LIKE fallback for empty queries. Exact/prefix/contains scoring overlay on BM25 results. Multi-word phrase matching.

features.name: Edge Detection & Call Graph
features.description: Edge building from parsed symbols: Contains (file→symbol), Defines (file→symbol), Imports (file→module), Calls (caller→callee with heuristic word-boundary detection), References. 14 edge types defined in EdgeType enum. Confidence scoring for heuristic edges.

features.name: Query Engine with Caching
features.description: QueryEngine with: search (FTS5+cache), functions/structs/classes/enums finders, by-language filter, pattern-to-kind mapping, in-file query, dependencies (BFS), reverse-dependencies, call-chains, hub nodes (incoming/outgoing degree), complexity hotspots (risk = complexity × degree), stats. QueryCache with TTL + LRU eviction.

features.name: Cypher-like Path Tracing (Recursive CTE)
features.description: Recursive SQL CTE for graph path tracing. trace_path(start_symbol, max_depth, reverse) returns TraversalPath entries with depth and path_str. Forward (callees) and reverse (callers) modes.

features.name: Hub Nodes & Complexity Hotspots
features.description: HubNodes: stable_id + incoming/outgoing/total edge counts via SQL aggregation. ComplexityHotspots: risk_score = complexity × (incoming + 1) for ranking high-risk functions.

features.name: Incremental Indexing Support
features.description: clear_by_file(file_path) deletes symbols/edges/refs/imports for one file. Enables per-file re-index without full DB wipe. Stable IDs with deterministic SHA-256-based generation ensure idempotent upserts across re-indexes.

features.name: File Watcher (AutoSync)
features.description: AutoSyncWatcher using notify crate: watches filesystem for Modify/Create/Remove events. Currently only LOGS the changed paths. Does NOT actually re-index. The incremental logic (clear_by_file + re-parse) is not connected.
features.notes: TODO: Connect watcher events to incremental re-index pipeline using clear_by_file + parse_file

features.name: Performance Benchmarks
features.description: 4 benchmarks: search_exact (100 queries < 1000ms), search_fuzzy (100 queries < 2000ms), insert (100 symbols < 500ms), find_by_kind (100 queries < 1000ms). 1000-symbol test database.

features.name: HTTP Server (Sidecar)
features.description: Axum HTTP server with: health (public), /code/scan (POST, auth), /code/find (POST, auth), /code/stats (GET, auth). Constant-time auth comparison, path traversal validation, configurable CORS (CODE_GRAPH_ALLOWED_ORIGINS), ephemeral token generation for non-loopback binds. CLI mode for scan/find/stats commands.

features.name: Debug CLI (DOT export, verify, list)
features.description: DebugCLI with: list_files (language stats), list_symbols (by kind filter), export_dot (DOT graph format for Graphviz), verify (index integrity check).

features.name: CI/CD Pipeline (GitHub Actions)
features.description: No CI/CD workflow configured specifically for code-graph crate. Must add: cargo test, cargo clippy -- -D warnings, cargo fmt --check on PR/merge to main. Xavier's root CI has tests but doesn't guarantee code-graph passes independently.

features.name: Code-graph Technical Documentation
features.description: ARCHITECTURE.md in code-graph/ doesn't exist. README.md is minimal (package description only). API docs only from rustdoc. Missing: architecture doc, feature list, usage guide, configuration reference.
